answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by demanding that every identity carry verifiable history rather than a cheap name. Recruits post collateral, complete randomized tasks, and gather attestations from reviewers outside their cluster. A pigment score records each signed contribution, an anchor of staked reputation ties the agent to its past, and a violet flag marks clusters whose behavior repeats suspiciously. Audits slash fake bonds, so swarms grow costly without gaining trust.
